notes: Only M_issuer is falsified on robust values (same ruling R-81, same issuer, force changes on adoption). M_adopter's falsification depends on coding choices for R-86. M_status is never contradicted by explicitly marked PREPARED/ADOPTED states; it is UNDETERMINED only because two 'none stated' rulings (R-70, R-95) have UNK force.

Most NOT-IN-FORCE values are derived, and the derivation uses the text's own PREPARED→not governing link (R-81, R-86). This makes the M_status test partly circular for R-89; R-81..R-85's NOT-IN-FORCE rests on R-86's 'become governing' wording rather than on the marker.

R-86 itself states the force rule in issuer terms: 'Any future ruling issued by the ARB Chief remains PREPARED, NOT ADOPTED, until the Decision Authority acts on it' — issuer determines default status, adoption act changes status, status gates force: the text's own shape is M_chain.
